answer: Score trust by the ancestral diversity of a node's endorsers, not their count. Trace each endorser back to its establishment origin; weight rises only when backing descends from many independent lineages spread across the graph's horizon. A farm's heads all trace to one seed voyage, a single lineage, so stacking more of them adds no diversity and its influence never nears the zenith. Honest members draw endorsement from unrelated roots and accrue real weight.
